why_sub: Smart vision meets generative AI to transform the ingredients you already have into practical, personalized meals — helping you cook smarter and waste less.
feature1_desc: AI analyzes your fridge photos and identifies visible ingredients with intelligent image understanding.
feature2_desc: Capture up to 5 photos, or simply speak what's in your fridge — we'll transcribe your voice note and combine everything into one complete ingredient list.
feature3_desc: Leverage Gemini's advanced vision capabilities to understand food images and identify ingredients.
feature4_desc: Turn the ingredients you already have into a practical recipe with servings, prep time, and clear instructions.
feature5_desc: Review your detected ingredients, correct mistakes, add missing items, or remove anything you don't want to use.
feature6_desc: Get an AI-generated preview of your finished meal and see the delicious result before you start cooking.
hiw_sub: Rescue your leftovers in three simple steps
step1_desc: Start by showing us what's inside your fridge. Take a live photo, upload up to 5 images, or simply speak out loud what you have — our AI is designed to work across different angles, lighting conditions, and even plain voice notes.
step1_check1: ✅ Camera, image upload, or voice note
step1_check2: ✅ Up to 5 photos in one scan
step2_desc: Once your photos are uploaded, Gemini Vision intelligently analyzes every image and turns what it sees into a clean, organized ingredient list. Review the results, make changes, and decide exactly what goes into your recipe.
step2_check1: ✅ Smart ingredient recognition with Gemini Vision
step2_check2: ✅ Review, edit, add, or remove ingredients
step2_check3: ✅ Merges ingredients from all your photos
step3_desc: Let Gemini transform your available ingredients into a delicious, personalized recipe. Get everything you need to start cooking — from preparation time and servings to clear step-by-step instructions and an AI-generated preview of your finished dish.
footer_brand_tagline: Turn what's left into something delicious.

footer_mission_text: Making everyday cooking smarter while helping households waste less food.
